name: Skirt
_about: A SKIRT: a cone of cloth HANGING from a ring round the torso -- the waist or the hips -- to its hem, clear of the hips and the stride (it swings behind it; the legs it covers are not drawn). `flare`: how much wider it gets for every metre down (at least what the hips ask); `pleats` fold it in the light; `dags` scallop its hem; `wrap` opens it (a coat's front); a hem band may border it. Soft folds by default (pleats 9: cloth hangs in folds, shell.js foldPhase); a stiff one -- padded, mail, a flat panel -- says pleats 0.
